description: Curated business/domain glossary. Only terms whose key appears in the parsed dataset or column names are injected into the agent prompt, keeping context focused. Extend this per client engagement.

terms.DND_NB: Distribution Node Number — the branch/node identifier; primary key across the branch staffing model.
terms.FTE: Full-Time Equivalent — the staffing quantity the model estimates and governs.
terms.TE_TNX: Teller transactions — volume of teller-executed transactions.
terms.TSL: Target Service Level — service-level target used in the staffing logit.
terms.AB: Actual Base / budgeted FTE baseline used as the model target.
terms.yr_month: Reporting period encoded as YYYYMM; the monthly grain key.
terms.util: Utilisation metric (sales/open/servicing) feeding the FTE estimate.
terms.guide: Guidance output — the governed FTE recommendation per node.
terms.finrep: FINREP — EU supervisory financial reporting framework.
terms.corep: COREP — EU supervisory capital/own-funds reporting framework.
